name: @w6w-apps/wakatime
description: Read coding-time stats, summaries, durations, projects, goals and leaderboards from WakaTime, and send heartbeats and external durations.

w6w.longDescription:
WakaTime tracks the time developers spend coding, automatically, through editor and IDE plugins. This app brings that data into a workflow: read a user's stats for a period, daily summaries, durations and raw heartbeats, per-project time and commits, goals, and private leaderboards.

It also writes: send heartbeats (singly or in bulk of up to 25) and external durations for activity no editor plugin sees, such as meetings, and request a data export. Insights and the all-time total give a workflow a cheap way to post a weekly coding report or react to a goal.

Authentication is the account's secret API key, sent over HTTP Basic. Health checks watch the API host; WakaTime publishes no machine-readable status feed or rate-limit headers, so those are declared unavailable.
